posts.text: Sunrise at the lake before day two of Devconnect. Spent breakfast reading the Glamsterdam EIP list: ePBS and block-level access lists in one fork is ambitious. Who's going to the zkEVM talk at 11?

comments.text: See you at 11! Row three, left side.

posts.text: Hot take: the best onboarding upgrade this year wasn't faster blocks. It was wallets showing what you're signing. https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7702 did more for new users than any airdrop.
